# Vendored test fixture: crypto_bitcoin OKF sample bundle

The `crypto_bitcoin/` directory is vendored verbatim from the public
Open Knowledge Format sample bundles in
https://github.com/GoogleCloudPlatform/knowledge-catalog
(path `okf/bundles/crypto_bitcoin/`, commit
`d44368c15e38e7c92481c5992e4f9b5b421a801d`), licensed under the
Apache License 2.0 (see `okf/LICENSE.md` in that repository).

It is used only as a round-trip / conformance test fixture for the
OKF 0.1 parser in this package. Do not edit these files.
